title: Storybound document
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/documents/<path>.json. The text lives in the resource pack: assets/<ns>/storybound/texts/<lang>/<content path>.sbt.

kind.description: book: two-page spread with page turning; scroll, note, letter, contract: one scrolling column.

content.description: The .sbt text id; defaults to the document id.

style.description: assets/<ns>/storybound/styles/<id>.json; defaults by kind: book_leather, scroll, note_torn, parchment.

category.description: Journal section; defaults by kind: books, scrolls, notes, letters, contracts. Name: '<ns>.journal.category.<path>'.

on_read.description: Runs on the player's first read only; never sent to clients.

custom_model_data.description: Applied to the item when issued; pair with an override in the item model.
